nodes.name: crud_tests.rs
nodes.summary: Unit test suite for work item CRUD covering round-trips, history events, soft delete/restore, label replacement, short-id allocation, and project moves.

nodes.name: enrichment.rs
nodes.summary: Enriches raw work items with resolved label, member, and project-name display data for presentation to the frontend.

nodes.name: execution_lock.rs
nodes.summary: Manages per-work-item execution locks so only one agent/session can actively work an item at a time.

nodes.name: extras.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the ExtrasPayload structure holding auxiliary work item metadata (todos, comments, history, orchestrator state, work products, etc.) and its frontmatter parsing.

nodes.name: history.rs
nodes.summary: Builds and appends audit-trail history events for work item lifecycle changes (created, deleted, restored, field/body mutations, comments).

nodes.name: mapping.rs
nodes.summary: Maps SQLite rows into WorkItem domain objects and provides generic query helpers usable across both direct connections and open transactions.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module that re-exports the work_items io submodules (atomic, batch, crud, enrichment, execution_lock, extras, history, mapping, orchestrator_view, sync_metadata, views) as the public work-item data-access surface.

nodes.name: orchestrator_view.rs
nodes.summary: Read/write helpers exposing work item orchestrator run state and linked-session data for the orchestrator subsystem, including interrupted-item recovery marking.

nodes.name: project_fixture
nodes.summary: Test fixture builder constructing a minimal project row for work item CRUD tests.

nodes.name: work_item_fixture
nodes.summary: Test fixture builder constructing a minimal work item row for CRUD tests.

nodes.name: write_then_read_round_trips_core_fields
nodes.summary: Test verifying that writing then reading a work item round-trips its core fields unchanged.

nodes.name: create_records_created_history_event
nodes.summary: Test verifying that creating a work item records a 'created' history event.

nodes.name: delete_moves_item_to_recoverable_bin_and_restore_clears_it
nodes.summary: Test verifying that delete moves an item to a recoverable state and restore clears the deleted marker.

nodes.name: write_then_read_derives_project_from_owning_project_id
nodes.summary: Test verifying the project association is correctly derived from the owning project id after write/read.

nodes.name: write_replaces_label_set_each_call
nodes.summary: Test verifying each write call fully replaces the work item's label set.

nodes.name: extras_round_trip_carries_todos_and_comments
nodes.summary: Test verifying extras fields (todos, comments) survive a write/read round trip.

nodes.name: read_all_orders_by_updated_at_desc
nodes.summary: Test verifying read_all returns work items ordered by updated_at descending.

nodes.name: delete_marks_row_deleted_and_preserves_durable_extras
nodes.summary: Test verifying delete marks the row deleted while preserving durable extras data.

nodes.name: allocate_short_id_increments_counter_and_skips_used_numbers
nodes.summary: Test verifying short-id allocation increments and skips already-used numbers.

nodes.name: allocate_short_id_skips_same_prefix_across_projects
nodes.summary: Test verifying short-id allocation avoids collisions for the same prefix reused across projects.

nodes.name: move_work_item_changes_project_id
nodes.summary: Test verifying moving a work item updates its owning project id.

nodes.name: move_work_item_rejects_destination_collision
nodes.summary: Test verifying move is rejected when the destination short id would collide.

nodes.name: upsert_preserves_created_at_on_second_write
nodes.summary: Test verifying a second write to an existing work item preserves its original created_at timestamp.

nodes.name: whole_row_write_preserves_sync_metadata_and_stamps_changed_fields
nodes.summary: Test verifying a full-row write preserves sync metadata while stamping changed field revisions.

nodes.name: read_all_work_items_enriched
nodes.summary: Reads all work items for a project with resolved label/member/project display data attached.

nodes.name: read_all_work_items_enriched_scoped
nodes.summary: Reads all work items for a project, scoped to an organization, with enrichment applied.

nodes.name: update_work_item_partial_enriched
nodes.summary: Applies a partial update to a work item and returns the enriched result.

nodes.name: read_work_item_enriched
nodes.summary: Reads a single work item with enrichment applied.

nodes.name: read_work_item_enriched_scoped
nodes.summary: Reads a single work item, scoped to an organization, with enrichment applied.

nodes.name: enrich_work_item
nodes.summary: Attaches resolved label, member, and project-name display fields to a raw work item.

nodes.name: resolve_person
nodes.summary: Resolves a member id into its display info using the provided member map.

nodes.name: read_project_name_by_id
nodes.summary: Reads a project's display name from the database by its internal id.

nodes.name: acquire_execution_lock
nodes.summary: Attempts to acquire an execution lock on a work item for a given session, failing if another session already holds it.

nodes.name: release_execution_lock
nodes.summary: Releases a previously acquired execution lock on a work item held by the given session.

nodes.name: from_frontmatter
nodes.summary: Parses an ExtrasPayload from a work item's raw frontmatter data.

nodes.name: ExtrasPayload
nodes.summary: Struct holding auxiliary work item data not part of the core schema: todos, comments, history, delegations, orchestrator state/config, work products, field revisions, and external refs.

nodes.name: ensure_created_event
nodes.summary: Ensures a work item's history contains a 'created' event, adding one if missing.

nodes.name: append_deleted_event
nodes.summary: Appends a 'deleted' event to a work item's history log.

nodes.name: append_restored_event
nodes.summary: Appends a 'restored' event to a work item's history log.

nodes.name: append_mutation_event
nodes.summary: Diffs the before/after state of a work item and appends the resulting field-change history events.

nodes.name: capture
nodes.summary: Captures a snapshot of a work item's history-relevant fields before mutation, for later diffing.

nodes.name: diff
nodes.summary: Diffs the captured history snapshot against the post-mutation frontmatter/body to produce a list of field changes.

nodes.name: push_change
nodes.summary: Appends a single field-change record to a changes list.

nodes.name: appended_comment
nodes.summary: Determines whether a mutation appended a new comment by comparing before/after comment lists.

nodes.name: history_event_id
nodes.summary: Generates a deterministic id for a new history event based on frontmatter, action, and timestamp.

nodes.name: WorkItemHistorySnapshot
nodes.summary: Struct capturing a point-in-time snapshot of a work item's history-relevant fields (title, body, status, assignee, labels, etc.) with capture/diff methods.

nodes.name: row_to_core
nodes.summary: Maps a database row into a work item's core field struct.

nodes.name: assemble_work_item
nodes.summary: Assembles a full WorkItem domain object from its core fields, labels, and extras.

nodes.name: read_labels_for
nodes.summary: Reads the labels associated with a given work item id.

nodes.name: read_extras_for
nodes.summary: Reads and parses the extras payload associated with a given work item id.

nodes.name: query_row_optional
nodes.summary: Generic helper querying an optional single row and mapping it via the given closure, implemented for both direct connections and open transactions.

nodes.name: query_string_rows
nodes.summary: Generic helper querying multiple rows into a vector of strings, implemented for both direct connections and open transactions.

nodes.name: ConnectionLike
nodes.summary: Trait abstracting over a rusqlite Connection and an open Transaction so query helpers can run against either uniformly.

nodes.name: read_orchestrator_state
nodes.summary: Reads the orchestrator run state stored in a work item's extras for the orchestrator subsystem to consume.

nodes.name: read_linked_sessions
nodes.summary: Reads the orchestrator session ids linked to a work item.

nodes.name: list_interrupted_work_items
nodes.summary: Lists work items whose orchestrator run was interrupted (e.g. by a crash) and needs recovery.

nodes.name: mark_work_items_interrupted
nodes.summary: Marks the given work items' orchestrator state as interrupted, for recovery on next startup.

nodes.name: extract_orchestrator_state
nodes.summary: Parses orchestrator run state out of a work item's raw extras JSON.

nodes.name: extract_linked_sessions
nodes.summary: Parses linked orchestrator session ids out of a work item's raw extras JSON.
